chronicle.models module

Database models for the chronicle app.

Defines the custom User, Publisher, Article and Newsletter models that power the quest_line news platform.

class chronicle.models.Publisher(*args, **kwargs)[source]

Bases: Model

A publisher that groups editors and journalists.

Articles can optionally belong to a publisher. Editors can approve their publisher’s articles and journalists write for that publisher.
